methodology: Option A: Independent Single-Set SSR for Six Constructs (Maier et al. adaptation)
embedding_notes: Local Ollama nomic-embed-text (768 dims) used instead of paper's OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for 100% offline, local execution.

construct_responses.PE: The Snapdragon 8 Elite processor ensures top-notch performance for heavy multitasking and gaming. The 2K AMOLED display and 6500mAh battery with fast charging will handle daily tasks efficiently, making work and study smoother. I am certain I will continue using this smartphone as my primary phone; the speed and efficiency match everything I need.
construct_responses.EE: The interface is intuitive, and the 2K AMOLED display provides vibrant visuals. The 120W fast charging and 6500mAh battery mean I won't waste time waiting for my phone to charge. I am certain I will continue using this smartphone as my primary phone; the ease of use is top-notch.
construct_responses.HM: The 200MP camera and advanced AI photography will be a game-changer for entertainment and gaming, with stunning visuals and crisp photos. The premium titanium design and 7 years of software support will definitely impress my college friends. I am certain I will continue using this smartphone as my primary phone; the display quality and camera are unbeatable.
construct_responses.SI: My friends and peers will be impressed by the premium titanium design and the advanced features of the Apex Ultra Pro Max. The social perception is that of a tech-savvy and stylish individual. I am certain I will continue using this smartphone as my primary phone; it's a status symbol in my circle.
construct_responses.PP: The advanced security features and long-term software updates provide peace of mind regarding personal data privacy. The 7 years of software support ensures that the phone remains secure and up-to-date. I am certain I will continue using this smartphone as my primary phone; I feel confident in its security.
construct_responses.BI: I am certain I will continue using this smartphone as my primary phone; the premium build quality, flagship processor, and display match everything I need. The price fits comfortably within my budget and I definitely intend to keep using it.
construct_responses.OVERALL: The Apex Ultra Pro Max ticks all the boxes for me, offering top-tier performance, a premium design, and advanced features. It's a perfect fit for my needs and budget, and I am confident I will continue using it.
